question: Does the ideation prove that removing the public gate eligibility ceremony preserves every fail-closed authority boundary and gives the operator a real status-to-acting-command journey with falsifiable refusal proof?

artifacts.summary: Ideation traces every production caller, keeps ConsumeAt and terminal delivery predicates under lock, removes only the public CLI/status diagnostic ceremony with no alias or new readiness class, and defines a real lifecycle plus stale/wrong-target/malformed refusal matrix and detached guard mutants. Focused gates, CLI, lifecycle, and status tests pass; the broad baseline retains the known absent shared-state manifest failure.
